rows.positiveSourceBasis: Independent Daijisen 耗 gives frictional wear; complete すれる 1595930 explicitly includes becoming worn and wearing out.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Scrape/scrub can describe the rubbing operation involved in 耗's attested frictional wear; this is broader than an exact synonym.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Wear down through use is defensible for 擦れる's positive wear-out sense.
rows.qualification: Not all rubbing causes depletion; a direct guard protects the overlapping wear reading.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Independent 耗 has すりへる; 摩 has rub/chafe/grind in its complete character record and rub/scrub/scrape in 摩する. The complete すれる family additionally retains rare 摩れる.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Rub/chafe is a consequential broad choice for the frictional-wear sense, although it need not name the resulting loss.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Wear down through use can fit the retained 摩れる wear-out sense; 摩する's drawing-near and pressing senses remain distinct.
rows.qualification: A conservative direct guard, not constituent equality inferred solely from 摩耗 and not universal rubbing/depletion identity.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 削る and the actual card include reducing an amount or cutting down; independent 耗 includes へる/へらす.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Shave/pare can fit the physical removal side of wearing down, not every numerical decrease.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease is defensible for 削る's independent reducing-amount sense, beyond physical shaving.
rows.qualification: The overlap is reduction, not a claim that every cut or reduction consumes resources.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Kanjipedia explicitly defines 耗's supplemental sense as たより/知らせ. Complete 便り 1512410 positively gives news, tidings and information as well as correspondence/letter.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Convenience is not a definition of 耗; the positive news nouns, rather than the first title, establish the overlapping semantic pair.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease/wear is not a definition of 便; the direct guard conservatively respects the independent shared secondary news sense in the two cards' complete ranges.
rows.qualification: Does not promote たより into metadata or practice, equate convenience with depletion, or make every written object news.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Daijisen and 字通 independently define 拍 hand-striking; complete 突く 1456890 includes hit/strike independently of thrust/prick.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Thrust/sudden is not the whole range; its striking region can be a defensible broad choice for hand-striking.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Clapping fits a hand-striking region, though a musical beat is not suddenness and not every 突く is clapping.
rows.qualification: Direct precaution for an ordinary striking overlap; no unrestricted allocation from the 打つ/拍つ family is needed.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 文/書 1505080 gives a formal/literary letter, note or mail, books and literary arts. Other complete 文 families retain sentence, design, scriptural and unit senses. Kanjipedia allocates 耗 to news/information, not unrestricted written objects.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Sentence/writing names composition or written expression; it does not define diminution, wear, or news as communicated content.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease/wear through use does not define 文's letter, composition, pattern or literary arts. A letter can convey news without being the noun for that news.
rows.qualification: The literary flag is retained, not used to discard the positive letter sense. This bounded content-versus-writing distinction is not an exhaustive denial of every historical use.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: New complete Daijisen 信 character entry explicitly gives a distant signal or tidings; the complete 日本国語大辞典 信 noun independently includes おとずれ/たより/音信. This goes beyond JMdict's received-message counter.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Trust/belief does not define 耗, but 信's independently established secondary news/tidings sense matches the positive 耗 news sense.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease/wear does not define trust or faith; the semantic guard protects the source-positive secondary news range rather than claiming the first titles are interchangeable.
rows.qualification: A message counter alone was insufficient. The new independently defined noun/character sense supports this direct precaution.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 疲れる 1483740 explicitly includes becoming worn out of a well-used object. Its fatigue and archaic starvation senses are retained. Independent 耗 has frictional wear and using up.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Grow tired may suggest exhausted reserves, but that whole-word association alone is not the decisive proof.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Wear down through use is directly defensible for 疲れる's well-used-object sense.
rows.qualification: This is new complete-family evidence for object wear, not a claim that all tiredness is bare-character depletion.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 磨く includes grinding a lens, scouring and scrubbing; complete 1595930 explicitly retains rare 磨れる with the wear-out sense. Independent 耗 is すりへる.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Polish/grind is a potentially defensible broad label for abrasion; skill refinement is not depletion.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Wear down through use is defensible for the rare but positively retained 磨れる wear-out sense, not merely the 磨耗 compound variant.
rows.qualification: Guard as a qualified rare-spelling/wear precaution. This does not make ordinary polishing identical to decrease or remove the spelling restriction.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 研ぐ 1598700 positively specifies sharpening/honing/whetting/grinding, rice washing, scouring/polishing/burnishing. 研磨 1592730 adds refining skills and disciplined study; rare 研く belongs to 磨く's surface/skill-refinement family, not the separate 磨れる wear-out family.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Polish/study closely specifies edge or surface treatment and refinement/research; it is not a name for the loss/depletion itself.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease/wear down through use does not define research, sharpening a useful edge or making a surface polished. Abrasive material loss can accompany that work without being the operation's definition.
rows.qualification: This disposition uses the actual full physical families, not just abstract study or a transitive 摩/研 guard. No exhaustive denial of every historical 研 sense is claimed.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 欠ける retains damage, becoming lost, shortage and explicitly waning of the moon; 欠く retains chipping/breaking/cracking and lack. Independent 耗 means decrease and has qualified damage/なくする senses.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Lack/gap is broader than depletion but may be a defensible reduced/deficient condition against the qualified 耗 damage/loss range.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease is defensible for the positive lunar-waning sense; it is not a definition of absence from a meeting or a missing team member.
rows.qualification: Direct precaution rests on positive diminution/damage evidence, not state-versus-action reasoning or the idea that every lack was caused by consumption.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 乏しい retains scarce/limited/destitute/lacking; 貧乏 retains poverty-stricken/destitute. Independent 字通 耗 positively retains impoverished/thin land and depletion, with historical qualifications.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Scarce/lacking can fit that qualified impoverished-resource range; numerical decrease does not always create scarcity.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease/wear is not the generic definition of poverty. A precaution covers the qualified depletion/insufficiency boundary, not a universal definition of 乏.
rows.qualification: Neither the financial/soil distinction nor an existing 貧 guard resolves the direct pair. Historical ordinary-use allocation remains qualified.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 枯れる gives plant withering/dying; 枯らす gives killing/drying vegetation and seasoning lumber. 字通 耗 positively discusses vegetation's 衰敗, while image-dependent historical glyph allocation is unresolved.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Wither/dry up can be a broad answer in that explicitly recorded plant-decline region of 耗.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease/wear can describe decline, but is not a full definition of plant death, lumber seasoning or personal maturation.
rows.qualification: Direct precaution for the positive qualified plant-deterioration range, without promoting all historical usages to ordinary modern synonyms.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 下げる 1184170 includes lower/reduce; 下がる 1184160 includes becoming lower, dropping and deterioration. Independent 耗 is decrease, not solely physical abrasion.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Down/below can denote the direction of an amount's decrease, beyond spatial examples.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease is directly defensible for lower/reduce/go-down senses; below/under, a lower volume and giving remain distinct.
rows.qualification: A numerical/quality reduction overlap, not a claim that every descent is resource depletion.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 落ちる 1548550 explicitly includes decreasing popularity, quality, speed or sales and declining/deteriorating; 落とす 1589260 includes lessen/reduce.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Fall down can be a broad answer for decreasing quantities, not just an object dropping spatially.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease is directly defensible for those positive amount/quality senses.
rows.qualification: Does not equate every fall, disappearance, failed exam or punch line with depletion.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete rare 退く ひく 1595086 independently includes lessen/subside/ebb/go down, usually written 引く. Other complete 退く families retain stepping aside, retreat and retirement.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Withdraw/retreat can be a consequential broad label for receding/ebbing, but the unallocated old 耗 strings alone are not proof.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease is defensible for the positively retained lessening/ebbing sense; resignation and stepping aside remain distinct.
rows.qualification: Qualified rare-spelling precaution; retains the usual-spelling restriction and does not infer a modern sense from untranslated old strings.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 用いる 1546210 gives use/utilize. Independent Daijisen 耗 explicitly specifies using so as to diminish, and the card teaches using up reserves.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Use is broad enough to be a consequential answer choice for using up, although purpose/business is not depletion.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease/wear through use is not a definition of every use or employment; the direct precaution prevents the broad use label competing with the taught consumptive use.
rows.qualification: No claim that all use consumes; this direct decision is independent of the existing 使 exclusion.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 鳴らす 1532880 includes beat, sound and snap fingers; independent 拍 means hand-striking/clapping. 鳴る's echo/roar and animal-call senses remain intact.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Ring is broader than clapping, but the independent sounding/beating action gives a consequential overlap beyond merely the audible result of applause.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Clap/beat is defensible for 鳴らす's positive beat/snap-fingers region, not for every animal call.
rows.qualification: No allocation of cymbal-sounding from the broad 拍つ family is required for this direct guard.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 響く 1238610 gives resounding, being heard at a distance, reverberating/vibrating, coming home/remain and effects/impressions. Complete 響き 1602130 names echo, distinctive sound and its quality/feeling; 1612890 separately retains rare 響く どよめく and kana preference.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Resound/echo names sound carrying or resonating, not the hand-striking/clapping operation or timed musical pulse. A clap can resound without resounding meaning clap.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Clap/musical beat is not a definition of sound resonance or an effect/impression reaching someone. The broad 打つ family's moving/impressing sense has no independent ordinary bare-拍 allocation here.
rows.qualification: Bounded distinction based on positive sound/effect definitions, not an exclusively audible treatment, a different-title shortcut or transitive 音 guards. Historical family allocation stays unresolved, not declared absent.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: The complete 勉 character record independently includes encourage; 努める/rare 勉める 1240820 gives exertion/endeavour. Independent 字通 拍 positively gives はやしたてる.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Strive/exert effort is not clapping, but the independently positive encouragement meaning prevents dismissing the pair by that first label.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Clap can name encouragement through applause, not 勉's every diligent-effort use.
rows.qualification: Conservative direct encouragement-label precaution; does not allocate all 勉める senses to ordinary 拍 or erase the rare spelling.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 勇 character record retains cheer up/high spirits; 勇む 1539700 gives high spirits, encouragement/liveliness; 勇ましい 1539660 includes stirring/vigorous/rousing. 拍 independently retains cheering.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Courage/bravery is not a definition of 拍, but the positive cheering/high-spirits boundary is consequential despite the first label.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Clap/beat is not a general definition of courage or eagerness; a direct precaution respects the positively sourced cheering region without asserting full synonymy.
rows.qualification: Do not replace encouragement of another with all states of bravery; guard is calibrated to that shared broad region.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 乗り 1354720 positively includes rhythm/enthusiasm with a kana-preferred qualification in that sense; 乗る 1355120 includes getting into the swing to sing/dance. Daijisen 拍 independently lists 乗り in its rhythm discussion.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Ride/board is not 拍's meaning; the positive secondary rhythm range, not boarding, motivates the guard.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Musical beat is a defensible broad choice in the secondary rhythm/keeping-time region, not in vehicle boarding, powers or multiplication.
rows.qualification: Preserve the kana-preferred sense qualification; do not make every instance of 乗り a literal pulse.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 記す/誌す/rare 識す 1223140 includes write, note, describe, inscribe, mark and remember. Complete 打つ/rare 拍つ 1408810 retains writing-in/marking without spelling-local allocation.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Record in writing is consequential against the retained but unallocated writing/marking region of the rare 拍つ family.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Clap/beat does not define ordinary 記す; the guard protects a broad allocation uncertainty rather than inventing a bare-拍 writing sense.
rows.qualification: Direct precaution, not established ordinary synonymy or transitive protection through 書; lexical allocation remains unresolved.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Independent complete 識 character record includes write; 2228450 includes written by after a signature, and rare 識す belongs to complete 1223140. Complete rare 拍つ family retains unallocated write-in/mark.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Knowledge/awareness does not define 拍, but the positive secondary writing sense meets the consequential family-allocation question.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Clap/beat is not a definition of knowledge, consciousness or writing. A precaution protects the retained unallocated writing region without promoting it to ordinary bare 拍.
rows.qualification: Retain the after-signature and rare-spelling qualifications; not a different-title or missing-source-only rationale.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 筆 1487770 distinguishes brush/pen, brush writing/penmanship and ふで-restricted composing text; ひつ also counts land plots. Complete rare 拍つ family retains unallocated writing-in/marking.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Brush/writing is consequential in that retained writing/marking region, not because every writing implement resembles a clapper.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Clap/beat does not define a brush, text composition or a land lot. Direct precaution covers the unresolved writing allocation, not every sense of 筆.
rows.qualification: Preserve reading restrictions and implement/action distinctions; no claim that bare 拍 ordinarily composes text.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 城 families distinguish castle/fortress/place-name suffix and archaic wall-surrounded fortification; 城壁 separately means defensive wall. New complete Daijisen 城 entries define a fortified place, not any fence. The separately attributed 字通 城 explicitly retains historical カキ among lookup forms.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Castle does not normally name a garden fence. The positive historical enclosing-wall lookup nevertheless motivates a qualified direct precaution.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Boundary wall/fence names the enclosing structure, not the whole castle or fortified town; it can meet that qualified historical カキ question.
rows.qualification: Not an inference of bare 城 wall solely from 城壁, nor resolution of the old form's modern range or image-only glyphs.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: Complete 書 2037940 gives book/document, calligraphy/penmanship/handwriting and letter/note; complete 文/書 1505080 retains literary letter/mail and books. Kanjipedia independently specifies 耗 news/information.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Write names composing/inscribing text, not the information or news conveyed; it is not a definition of decrease/wear or the positive news noun.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease/wear is not a definition of 書's writing, document, calligraphy or letter. A letter can convey news without being interchangeable with its content.
rows.qualification: Does not discard the secondary letter noun, rely just on different first titles, or infer protection through 拍/書. Bounded writing/content distinction, not an exhaustive historical negative.

rows.positiveSourceBasis: New complete Daijisen 音 character entry independently gives たより under both オン and イン; its おと entry also retains visiting/tidings as a quoted historical sense. Kanjipedia 耗 independently has たより/知らせ.
rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Sound is not depletion or news; nevertheless the independently attested news/tidings character sense overlaps 耗 without inference from 音耗.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Decrease/wear does not define sound or its phonetic/music uses. Guard covers the shared positive secondary news range.
rows.qualification: Does not claim a counter or a compound alone proves the noun. Keeps historical examples distinct from ordinary sound and does not promote supplemental readings.

policy: Actual complete cards and independently positive complete families; both displayed directions and secondary ranges. Direct symmetric exclusions, never transitive. A precaution is not a proven ordinary synonym.
remainingLexicalUncertainty: Historical image glyphs, old lookup allocation and per-spelling allocation of the broad rare 拍つ family are NOT resolved. Precautions protect the specified broad choices without making those uncertain senses ordinary modern teaching.
limits: Finite 28-pair author reconciliation; not fresh independent review, whole-index safety, arbitrary/custom/multiple-borrow/native/device/visual or publication acceptance.
